description: This file defines the Mail class as part of the OpenCart system, providing an abstraction layer for sending emails using different adaptors. It manages email properties such as recipient, sender, subject, body, and attachments, and delegates sending to a specified adaptor class.

classes.name: Mail
classes.description: A class providing email functionalities including setting recipients, sender, subject, content, and sending emails through different adaptors.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the Mail object with a specified adaptor class and options.

methods.name: setTo
methods.description: Sets the recipient(s) of the email.

methods.name: setSender
methods.description: Sets the sender's name or email.

methods.name: setText
methods.description: Sets the plain text body of the email.

methods.name: setHtml
methods.description: Sets the HTML body of the email.

methods.name: addAttachment
methods.description: Adds an attachment file to the email.

methods.name: send
methods.description: Sends the email using the configured adaptor.
